g.text: From a reservation to a mapped page
a zone is added to the list;
every entry in the page table is invalid
the MMU finds no frame for the page
a free frame is zero-filled, and the
entry now says: valid, frame X
from now on this page costs nothing;
the other three are still unpaid
malloc() and mmap() do step 1 only. Steps 2 to 4 happen at the first access to each page, once, and never again while the page stays in memory.
